before.itinerary: Day 1 (Cascade Pass to Kool-Aid Lake): 4-6 hours, 1,700 ft gain. Hike Cascade Pass Trail to the pass (5.7 miles), then off-trail south to Cache Col crossing on Cache Glacier, descend over red ledges and across Middle Cascade Glacier to Kool-Aid Lake bivouac (elevation ~7,000 ft). Day 2 (Kool-Aid to Yang-Yang Lakes): 8-11 hours, 2,500 ft gain/loss. Traverse Spider-Formidable Col via Middle Cascade Glacier, cross exposed red ledges (Class 3 scrambling), descend to Yang-Yang Lakes bivouac. Day 3 (Yang-Yang to White Rock Lakes): 7-11 hours, 2,000 ft gain/loss. Traverse Le Conte Ridge, cross Le Conte Glacier with crevasse hazards, descend to White Rock Lakes bivouac (visual highlight of entire route). Day 4 (White Rock rest day or peak day): Optional day to summit Dome Peak (8,924 ft) via Dome Glacier route (moderate ice climbing, 35-degree terrain) or rest for acclimatization. Day 5 (White Rock to Itswoot Ridge): 8-10 hours, 3,000 ft gain. Ascend Dana Glacier crossing bergschrund, summit Spire Point (8,264 ft) or traverse below on east face, descend to Itswoot Ridge bivouac. Day 6 (Itswoot to Downey Creek TH): 8-12 hours, 2,500 ft loss. Descend Bachelor Creek through forest, reach Downey Creek Trailhead. Alternative faster options: out-and-back from Cascade Pass (4-5 days), or extend to Dome Peak summit and add Sentinel Peak/Old Guard (7-8 days).

before.watch_out:
2-3 day alpine commitment with multiple peaks crossed
Mixed terrain with rock, ice, and snow
Extensive glacier travel across multiple systems
Weather exposure on high altitude ridge traverse
Navigation complexity across multiple peaks and saddles
Spider Glacier crossings and other technical sections

access.fees: N/A - no fee for day travel; overnight camping inside the North Cascades NP portion needs a wilderness permit costing $10 per person (youth 15 and under free), plus a $6 non-refundable reservation fee for advance reservations. A walk-up permit from the Marblemount Wilderness Information Center avoids the reservation fee, not the $10.
access.notes: The traverse crosses two jurisdictions: the southern Cascade Pass-to-Yang Yang Lakes stretch is Mount Baker-Snoqualmie/Okanogan-Wenatchee National Forest (Glacier Peak Wilderness), and the northern Cascade Pass/Cache Col/Ptarmigan Traverse proper runs through North Cascades National Park (Stephen Mather Wilderness).
access.rules: Group size capped at 6 in off-trail cross-country zones inside the park; 12 in on-trail National Forest corridors.
access.permit: Wilderness permit required for any overnight stay inside North Cascades National Park (obtain from the Marblemount Wilderness Information Center); a free self-issue National Forest wilderness permit covers the southern, non-park portion.
access.closures: Cascade River Road (the standard entry trailhead) has a history of seasonal washouts/closures — check the current NPS road-conditions page before a trip.
access.landManager: North Cascades National Park (Stephen Mather Wilderness) / Mount Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest (Glacier Peak Wilderness)
access.land_manager: National Park Service — North Cascades National Park, and USDA Forest Service — Mount Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest
